[SWS_DM_00111] Configurable environment condition checks
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04199
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall perform a condition check when the ISO
14229-1[1] mentions a service specific "Condition check" in the defined NRC handling
for a given diagnostic service. The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall send the
configured NRC value (see [SWS_DM_00289]) if the condition is not fulfilled.
⌋
